citation: Chang, Hong and Liskovich (2015, RFS 28(1)) Regression discontinuity and the price effects of stock market indexing
formula: russell_recon (engine-only C++ kind, atx-engine russell_recon_field.hpp, formula id russell-recon-r1k-r2k-move-v1): on the house Russell proxy (atx-db indexes stage, rule russell-proxy-v1), +1 for a line in the R1000 at the prior reconstitution and in the R2000 at the upcoming one (predicted R2000 addition), -1 for the reverse move, 0 for a line that stays; read from the session after the rank date's 22:00 UTC visibility to the last session before the reconstitution day
domain: NaN outside the yearly event window (about 30 sessions, rank date to the June reconstitution), for a line not in both proxy snapshots or in both indexes of one, and before the stage's second reconstitution (2019; the proxy holds 2018-06 on)
deviation: house proxy of the Russell lists (official lists unlicensed): its own rank and band rules, no float adjustment, IPO and spin-off additions not modelled; every predicted boundary crosser is signed, not only those near the rank-1000 cutoff of the CHL discontinuity; window from the proxy's rank date (May, the last business day of April from 2023) to the day before the reconstitution, where CHL hold May to July; one variant, nothing tuned
notes: horizon class medium, half-life 21 sessions (PM8-5: the price pressure builds over the window and the CHL effect reverts after the reconstitution, so the field is NaN from the reconstitution day); bar of lit section 3.0 argued from the mechanism, not measured: rho to the book about 0 (lit 3.1 F8: index-flow demand at one yearly date, spanned by no theme), small breadth (the boundary crossers, tens of lines a year), so the gain is small (+.00 to +.02 lit section 6) and the string also serves root as a do-no-harm trade-filter input
predicted_mechanism: benchmark weight jumps for a line that crosses from the Russell 1000 to the Russell 2000 and falls for the reverse move, so index-fund demand pushes the predicted R2000 additions up and the predicted R1000 additions down before the June reconstitution
